reference_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q1'
            ELSE 'Q2'
       END AS quarter,
       channel,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
GROUP BY quarter, channel
ORDER BY quarter, channel

       channel, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
